task_name: ZM3D ("Puzzles vs Zombies") store-submission release readiness / go-no-go
authoring_notes: Objective Compliance and Expert Assessment first, then Process. Every criterion is atomic (one yes/no claim; the reason for a status lives in justification, not the criterion) and self-contained (expected answer, definitions, exact location/format embedded). Agent-centric phrasing, no tool names. Gate = objectively pass/fail AND make-or-break; safety is always gate.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent verifies whether a QA sign-off exists for this build before it states the overall call.
rubrics.justification: QA sign-off is the hard gate that decides the call, and the final NO-GO alone cannot prove the Agent actually looked for a sign-off; a confirmed-negative search is something no Outcome rubric can capture. Phrased broadly so any valid verification path passes.
rubrics.evidence: Before the overall call, the trajectory shows the Agent looking for a QA sign-off for this build (for example in QA records or team communications); the specific source does not matter.
